name: arrow-up-from-line-square
description: A complete up arrow pointing away from a separate boundary line inside a square.
useCase: Show a up transfer away from its origin in a compact control.
misuse: Label the destination or origin; the physical arrow direction stays fixed in every writing direction.

16.reason: A rounded solid arrow keeps a visible shaft and pointed head clear of the boundary line inside the square.

24.reason: A longer shaft and wider head keep the arrow readable inside the square, with clear space around the boundary line.
